items.title: Which fix actually shortens the line?
items.description: 60 students move through two food lanes each wave. Each one spends about 40 seconds deciding what to take at the food station, plus 8 seconds paying at the register. The 'obvious' fix is more registers. Drag the menu-board slider to see what cutting decision time does instead — and compare it to just adding registers on the chart, which sweeps registers from 1 to 6 with today's menu-board setting held fixed.

params.name: menuBoardReduction
params.label: Decision time cut by menu board

items.compute: const students = 60; const foodLanes = 2; const hesitationSeconds = 40 * (1 - params.menuBoardReduction / 100); const checkoutSeconds = 8; const decisionMinutes = (hesitationSeconds * students) / foodLanes / 60; const checkoutMinutes = (checkoutSeconds * students) / params.registers / 60; const totalMinutes = decisionMinutes + checkoutMinutes; return { totalMinutes };

outputs.label: Time for the whole wave to get through
